simple.meaning: to kneel ; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בָּרַךְ (H1288) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 330 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בָּרַךְ (bârak) means to kneel ; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 4 10.

definitions.full: H1288. barak [ בָּרַךְ ] 329 verb kneel, bless (Late Hebrew id. ; Arabic ; Ethiopic : Aramaic בְּרֵךְ ( praise ), Palmyrene especially in לעלמא שמו בריך Vog Palm. 74 ff. compare 94, 144) — Qal Imperfect יִבְּרַךְ 2Chr 6:13 ; נִבְרְכָה Psa 95:6 ; בָּרוֺךְ (see Pi`el ); Passive participle בָּרוּךְ Gen 9:26 70t.; — 1 kneel down (so Arabic, Syriac, Ethiopic): עַלבִּֿרְכָּיו וַיִּבְרַךְ and he kneeled upon his knees 2Chr 6:13 ; י לפני ׳נִבְרְכָה let us kneel before Yahweh Psa 95:6 . 2 bless (only passive participle). a. of God: י ׳בָּרוּךְ blessed be (or is ) ׳י Exod 18:10 (E) Gen 9:26 ; 24:27 (J) Ruth 4:14 ; 1Sam 25:32 : 25:39 ; 2Sam 18:28 ; 1Kin 1:48 ; 1 Kings 5:21; 8:51 , 56 ; 10:9 ; 1Chr 16:36 ; 29:10 ; 2Chr 2:11 ; 6:4 ; 9:8 ; Ezra 7:27 ; Psa 28:6 ; 31:22 ; Psalm 41:14; 72:18 ; Psalm 89:53; 106:48 ; 119:12 ; 124:6 ; 135:21 ; 144:1 ; Zech 11:5 ; ׳ב אלהים Psa 66:20 ; Psalm 68:36; ׳ב אדני 68:20 (probably for an original יהוה ); ׳ב עליון אל Gen 14:20 (E); ׳ב צוּרִי 2Sam 22:47 (= Psa 18:47 ); ׳ב י ׳כבוד Ezek 3:12 ; כבודו ׳ב שׁם Psa 72:19 . b. of men: Gen 27:33 (J) Num 22:12 (E) Deut 7:14 ; 28:3 , 6 ; 33:20 , 24 ; 1Sam 25:33 ; 26:25 ; Judg 17:2 ; 1Kin 2:45 ; Psa 118:26 ; Isa 19:25 ; Jer 17:7 ; 20:14 ; ברוך מברכך blessed be the one blessing thee Gen 27:29 ; Num 24:9 (E); ׳ב ליהוה Ruth 2:19-20 , 3:10 ; 1Sam 15:13 ; 23:21 ; 2Sam 2:5 ; Psa 115:15 ; ׳ב עליון לאל Gen 14:19 ; י ׳בְּרוּךְ 24:31 ; 26:29 (J); י ׳בְּרוּכֵי Isa 65:23 . c. things: בטנך פרי בָּרוּךְ blessed be the fruit of thy womb Deut 28:4 compare 28:5 ; 1Sam 25:33 ; Prov 5:18 .
